claims: Working one of these attracts public holiday penalty rates under most awards.
whys: 'most awards' is an unsourced population claim.

claims: If you work in the Pilbara, the Kimberley or the Goldfields, you may also be entitled to the federal zone tax offset
whys: Under ATO rules, zone tax offset eligibility depends on your usual place of residence in the zone (183 days). Fly-in fly-out workers whose usual home is outside the zone have been excluded since 2015, so 'if you work in' overstates who qualifies.
constants: zone tax offset copy / ATO zone tax offset source in lib/constants

claims: WA is the most generous state at the exit (pro-rata payment after 7 years, including on resignation)
whys: Victoria's Long Service Leave Act 2018 also pays pro rata after 7 years on any termination, and it lets the leave be taken from 7 years. The ACT pays pro rata from 5 years in some cases. The 'most generous' comparison looks wrong.

claims: If your employer is a Pty Ltd company, you are in the national system
whys: The national system covers constitutional (trading or financial) corporations. A Pty Ltd that is a non-trading corporation sits in the WA state system, and the site's own state-minimum-wage.tsx line 24 lists non-trading corporations as state-system employers.

claims: if you do not work [a public holiday] you are still entitled to be absent without losing pay
whys: Only permanent (full-time and part-time) employees are paid for a public holiday that falls on an ordinary working day. Casuals are not paid when they do not work, so the sentence is too broad.
constants: PenaltyRateNote copy; FWO public holidays source

claims: The next dollar ... taxed at X, which is your tax bracket rate plus the {formatPercent(0.02, 0)} Medicare levy
whys: The Medicare levy rate is hardcoded as 0.02 here instead of being read from MEDICARE_LEVY.rate, so it will not follow a constant change. Also, low earners in the Medicare levy shade-in range pay a different marginal levy.
